objective: Causal isolation: holding spatial geometry, native bonds, native species, valence and chemical pair lottery fixed, can ONE previously introduced passive energy-conduction pass along naturally formed native chemical bonds directly enable and cause real ORIGINAL-cohort-to-external native bonds? Distinguish generic diffusion and matched-count unbonded transport; no 120-step trajectory or global RNG divergence.

sample.source_selection: EXACT unchanged M7.5 natural no_transfer source selection (first maximal connected 5..16 member native component, >=4 native bonds, >=1 spare native valence, >=2 original material edge pairs continuously present for >=20 ticks, source scan tick1..500, first eligible from tick120, lexicographically smallest IDs). At most one cohort per independent numeric seed; retain all missing sources.
sample.source_native_world: unchanged M7.3 dispersed energy source config: 264 particles, 24x24 periodic, movement energy cost1, zero initial bonds, native reversible chemistry no catalysis
sample.independent_statistical_unit: one numeric source seed. 32 paired exogenous lotteries per source are repeated trials on same physical snapshot, NOT independent world units.

interventions.sham: Deep clone complete original native fork state; apply no transfer.
interventions.bond_only: Deep clone same original native fork state; apply exactly ONE existing M7.3 energy_transfer(world,'bond_only') pass. No advance() and no native reaction beforehand.
interventions.all_contacts: Deep clone same fork state; apply exactly ONE existing M7.3 energy_transfer(world,'all_contacts') pass, positive comparator with added unbonded routes; not cost-matched to bond_only.
interventions.unbonded_budget_matched: Deep clone same fork state; perform one snapshot-gradient >=2 single quantum per cardinal NON-BONDED pair, sorted by persistent material IDs; donor budgeted and simultaneous, stop after at most N accepted transfers where N is the accepted bond_only M7.3 events for same snapshot. If insufficient eligible nonbonded edges, explicitly record shortfall; matching event count does NOT match recipients/transport locations or equality of effects.
interventions.physical_freeze: No movement, breaking, decay, source injection or topology change during transfer. Per-particle energies can change; total sum remains exactly fixed, original world RNG fingerprint/draws unchanged.

chemistry.draw_key: SHA256 ASCII of 'alife-m7-8|'+source_numeric_seed+'|'+lottery_salt+'|'+smaller_persistent_material_ID+'|'+larger_persistent_material_ID, take 64-bit unsigned first 8 digest bytes in big endian. This DRAW is identical for a given unordered material pair across all four arm clones and irrespective of whether other candidate pairs are enumerated.
chemistry.operator: A separate one-sweep FORMATION ONLY from frozen post-transfer state: exactly original chemistry._candidate_pairs candidate iterator, same canonical particle index neighbor sweep, same M6 native formation_threshold and subsequent rechecks for valence/energy/existing bonds, same costs and stored bond energy+native dissipation. The ONLY change from M6 form_bonds is replacing global rng.raw() with deterministic pair-keyed draw. No native advance, movement, breaking, sources or decay. Report this as an EXPERIMENTAL ISOLATED CHEMISTRY COUNTERFACTUAL, NOT native full-step outcome.
chemistry.physical_checks: Every chemistry variant starts as clone of same post-transfer arm state. Verify original bonds and positions/species unchanged before formation, same pair hashed draw in every arm. Verify exact energy accounting and invariants after native bond payments. Check per-arm original complete world and RNG unchanged.
chemistry.endpoint: For each salt, observe number and existence of newly formed chemical bonds with exactly one endpoint among ORIGINAL source persistent IDs; separately all new bonds and coherent attachment of outsiders. Do not attribute internal/new outside bonds to source recruitment.

measures.static_interface: Before/after one energy pass, count native geometrically adjacent unbonded original-to-external contacts; species and unused valence-eligible subset; those with BOTH endpoints >=native formation_cost. Verify species/valence geometry invariant across arms and energy qualification alone varies.
measures.bond_original_energy: Original root particle energy change and total world particle energy before/after. Bond-only flux is wholly internal for maximal source cohort and must not change original root total energy.
measures.paired_actual_reaction: Per-seed mean over 32 COUPLED pair-hash lotteries of NEW original-cohort-to-outside bonded attachments; compare bond_only vs sham. Record casewise per-salt event counts, first material IDs and world hash in raw data.
measures.negative_control: Matched-budget unbonded contact energy routing; record if exact budget matched and any shortfalls. Even a matched transfer count is not equal topology/recipient matching.
measures.full_hashes: Per parent selected, sha256 full state and RNG/draws, per arm post-transfer full state hash, per lottery post-reaction hash, original source IDs/edges, exact transfer budget and donor/recipient counts, ledgers.

preregistered_decisions.primary_direct_eligibility: For >=40 eligible independent source worlds and >=20 NON-TIED source-level pairs comparing ORIGINAL-to-EXTERNAL energy-qualified interface counts after ONE bond_only pass vs untouched sham, at least 4/5 of discordant source worlds must favor bond_only. Also require at least 15 source worlds with strictly positive bond_only-sham difference. Otherwise not_met_or_underpowered; no revised seed/sample/time constraints.
preregistered_decisions.secondary_direct_actual_formation: For >=15 non-tied independent SOURCE seeds comparing mean original-to-external native bond formations over the 32 PAIR-COUPLED hash lotteries after one energy-only intervention, at least 2/3 of non-tied seeds must favor bond_only over sham. Means are per seed, NOT per 32 independent units. Otherwise not_met_or_underpowered.
preregistered_decisions.tertiary_specificity: Report bond-only vs budget-matched NONBONDED transfer and all-contacts controls, both outcome rates and coverage of requested matched transfer counts; NO confirmatory superiority threshold for structural specificity in M7.8. A sham gain alone does not mean topology-specific superiority.
